w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds you — no dodging it.
firstContext: The tiger's head swings toward Meihua. You're on the list now — it doesn't forget.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You catch fragments by the fire — Finn telling Ivy about Tariq. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
